'''Neile Janna''' was a noted [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] actress, director and producer. Janna returned from a twenty-year hiatus shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] to work on a holofilm called ''[[Kallea's Hope]]''.
